exception.replacementProposed.body: Carrier proposed replacement vehicle {{vehicle}} and driver {{driver}} for "{{jobTitle}}". Open the job to approve or reject.
exception.replacementProposed.email.send: CLOX — approve replacement crew for your job
Your carrier proposed a replacement vehicle/driver. Open CLOX to Approve (continue) or Reject (cancel + refund).
